messages.raw: §fThe underworld took control of my tavern in the real world.
messages.text: The underworld took control of my tavern in the real world.
messages.zh: 冥界占领了我在现实世界里的酒馆。

messages.raw: §fIt's great! Business has been booming here!
messages.text: It's great! Business has been booming here!
messages.zh: 这可太好了! 我在这里的生意红火得很!

messages.raw: §fPlus, I get to be comfortable in my own skin.
messages.text: Plus, I get to be comfortable in my own skin.
messages.zh: 而且，我终于能自在地做自己了。

messages.text: Oops! That elixir is sold out!
messages.zh: 哎呀! 那种药剂卖光了!
